dct_description_sm: Environics Focus Canada (EFC) is a regular public opinion survey of Canadian citizens which has been in the field since the mid-1970s. Currently, data are available through the Canadian Opinion Research Archive from mid-1978. EFC includes items which tap Canadian partisan loyalties at both the federal and provincial levels. EFC is produced by Environics Research Group Limited, Toronto, Ontario.
